text: Entry 1506 moves -gline-tables-only from an optimize argument into --enable-debug-symbols and removes redundant optimize/debug options in the changed configurations. Current Linux ASan keeps the dedicated option, while debug Searchfox still explicitly enables debug. Proposed pattern for these mozconfigs: use the purpose-specific option for symbol detail and inspect sourced common configs before claiming an effective optimization mode. No paired Gecko configure/build was run. Static source and test-code inspection only. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime or live accessibility result is claimed.
title: Configure debug-symbol detail through its dedicated mozconfig option
